relationships.evidence_quote: These results reveal that CGRP-R antagonism was effective at preventing changes in periorbital thresholds in the setting of raised ICP.

relationships.subject: raised intracranial pressure
relationships.evidence_quote: Animals with raised ICP exhibited reduced mechanical thresholds

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: We did not find an effect of CGRP-R antagonism on ICP

key_findings: Raised ICP caused cephalic and hind paw allodynia, prolonged spreading depolarization and depleted ATP/ADP/NAD+.
Exenatide lowered ICP and rescued thresholds; olcegepant prevented periorbital allodynia without lowering ICP.
